description: Core data layer: DashboardStatsService with all 12 query methods plus ReportPdfService and its PDF Blade template. These are pure service classes with no Filament dependency — they are the foundation FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 depend on.
steps:
1. Create app/Services/DashboardStatsService.php with namespace App\Services. Inject no Auth; accept Organization/int parameters. Implement all methods listed below using LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes() and Organization::withoutGlobalScopes() throughout.

   schoolStatusCounts(Organization $org): array
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id', $org->subtreeIds())->selectRaw('status, count(*) as cnt')->groupBy('status')->pluck('cnt','status')->toArray(). Return array keyed by status string value, e.g. ['draft'=>2,'approved'=>5,...]. Ensure all 7 statuses are present (default 0 if missing) using array_merge with zero-defaults over LeaveStatus cases.

   onLeaveToday(Organization $org): Collection
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->with(['employee','leaveType'])->whereIn('organization_id',$org->subtreeIds())->where('status',LeaveStatus::APPROVED->value)->where('start_date','<=',today())->where('end_date','>=',today())->limit(20)->get().

   pendingRequests(Organization $org): Collection
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->with(['employee','leaveType'])->whereIn('organization_id',$org->subtreeIds())->whereIn('status',[LeaveStatus::SUBMITTED->value,LeaveStatus::IN_REVIEW->value])->orderBy('submitted_at')->get().

   employeeBalanceSummary(Organization $org): array
   — Query: LeaveBalance::join('employees','employees.id','=','leave_balances.employee_id')->join('leave_types','leave_types.id','=','leave_balances.leave_type_id')->whereIn('employees.organization_id',$org->subtreeIds())->where('leave_balances.year',now()->year)->selectRaw('leave_types.name as type_name, AVG(leave_balances.entitled) as avg_entitled, AVG(leave_balances.used) as avg_used')->groupBy('leave_types.id','leave_types.name')->get()->toArray().

   administrationSchoolStats(Organization $adm): Collection
   — Get direct child school orgs: Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('parent_id',$adm->id)->get(). For each school, query LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes() scoped to that school's subtreeIds(). Return Collection of arrays: ['name','total_requests','pending','approved','rejected','rejection_rate']. rejection_rate = rejected / total * 100, rounded to 1 decimal.

   topLeaveTakers(Organization $adm, int $limit=10): Collection
   — Query: Employee::withoutGlobalScopes()->join('leave_requests','leave_requests.employee_id','=','employees.id')->join('organizations','organizations.id','=','employees.organization_id')->whereIn('employees.organization_id',$adm->subtreeIds())->where('leave_requests.status',LeaveStatus::APPROVED->value)->selectRaw('employees.id, employees.full_name, organizations.name as school_name, SUM(leave_requests.days) as total_days, COUNT(leave_requests.id) as request_count')->groupBy('employees.id','employees.full_name','organizations.name')->orderByDesc('total_days')->limit($limit)->get().

   avgResponseTime(Organization $adm): float
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id',$adm->subtreeIds())->whereIn('status',[LeaveStatus::APPROVED->value,LeaveStatus::REJECTED->value])->whereNotNull('submitted_at')->whereNotNull('decided_at')->selectRaw('AVG((julianday(decided_at) - julianday(submitted_at)) * 24) as avg_hours')->value('avg_hours') ?? 0.0. Return as float rounded to 1.

   rejectionRateByReason(Organization $adm): Collection
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id',$adm->subtreeIds())->where('status',LeaveStatus::REJECTED->value)->whereNotNull('rejection_reason')->selectRaw('rejection_reason, COUNT(*) as count')->groupBy('rejection_reason')->orderByDesc('count')->get().

   directorateAdminStats(Organization $dir): Collection
   — Get direct child administrations: Organization::withoutGlobalScopes()->where('parent_id',$dir->id)->get(). For each adm, compute total_requests, approved_count, pending_count from LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id',$adm->subtreeIds()), and avg_response_hours using same julianday formula. Return Collection of arrays: ['name','total_requests','approved_count','pending_count','avg_response_hours'].

   monthlyRequestTrend(Organization $dir, int $year): array
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id',$dir->subtreeIds())->whereYear('created_at',$year)->selectRaw('strftime(\'%m\', created_at) as month, COUNT(*) as count')->groupBy('month')->pluck('count','month')->toArray(). Build array of 12 elements (index 0=Jan): for($m=1;$m<=12;$m++) use str_pad($m,2,'0',STR_PAD_LEFT) as key, default 0.

   yearlyComparison(Organization $dir, int $years=3): array
   — For last $years years from now()->year back: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('organization_id',$dir->subtreeIds())->whereYear('created_at',$y)->count(). Return array keyed by year string.

   overdueCount(?Organization $org=null): int
   — Query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->whereIn('status',[LeaveStatus::SUBMITTED->value,LeaveStatus::IN_REVIEW->value])->where('submitted_at','<',now()->subDays(config('leave.overdue_days',3))). When $org is not null, add ->whereIn('organization_id',$org->subtreeIds()). Return ->count().

2. Create app/Services/ReportPdfService.php with method generateSummary(array $filters): string.
   — Build query: LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes()->with(['employee.organization','leaveType']). Apply the same filter keys as LeaveRequestsExport: 'status', 'organization_id', 'leave_type_id', 'date_range.from', 'date_range.to'.
   — Compute $statusBreakdown: group results by status, compute count and percentage (count/total*100).
   — Compute $topEmployees: from the filtered results, group by employee, sum days, take top 10, each as ['name'=>$emp->full_name,'school'=>$emp->organization->name??'—','total_days'=>$sum].
   — Load Blade view: Barryvdh\DomPDF\Facade\Pdf::loadView('pdf.report-summary',compact('filters','statusBreakdown','topEmployees'))->output().
   — Return the binary string.

3. Create resources/views/pdf/report-summary.blade.php with inline CSS (same style as leave-request.blade.php: DejaVu Sans, RTL, #1e3a5f header color).
   — Header section: وزارة التربية والتعليم / تقرير الإجازات / generated date.
   — Filter summary section: list applied filters (date range, org name, leave type, status).
   — Status breakdown table: columns (الحالة / العدد / النسبة %) with alternating row colors.
   — Top 10 employees table: columns (الترتيب / اسم الموظف / المدرسة / إجمالي الأيام).
   — Footer: page number, generated by system.
acceptance_criteria: DashboardStatsService class exists at app/Services/DashboardStatsService.php with all 12 public methods
ReportPdfService class exists at app/Services/ReportPdfService.php with generateSummary(array $filters): string
resources/views/pdf/report-summary.blade.php exists with RTL inline CSS and three sections

./vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Phase5Test.php --compact passes tests 1 (schoolStatusCounts), 2 (onLeaveToday), 3 (topLeaveTakers), 4 (monthlyRequestTrend), 5 (overdueCount), 6 (ReportPdfService returns non-empty PDF binary starting with %PDF)

findings: 1) SQLite julianday() used for avg response time calculation — standard SQLite date arithmetic, no issues. 2) monthlyRequestTrend uses strftime('%m', created_at) with SQLite — returns zero-padded month strings matching str_pad keys. 3) PHP 8.5 deprecation warning for PDO::MYSQL_ATTR_SSL_CA appears in all tests — pre-existing framework vendor issue, not related to this feature. Pest shows tests as 'deprecated' (not 'passed') when deprecation warnings fire, but exit code is 0 and all 24 assertions pass. 4) LeaveRequest::withoutGlobalScopes() and Organization::withoutGlobalScopes() used consistently throughout DashboardStatsService. 5) employeeBalanceSummary groups by both leave_types.id and leave_types.name for SQLite GROUP BY compatibility.
